title: Save your money and your waffles
text: Save your money and your waffles. This is a complete waste of money.  It destroys waffles, in the process of picking them up.  A simple fork works much better to remove light fluffy waffles from the waffle maker.

product_metadata.title: Tovolo Waffle Tongs, Mini Silicone Easy-Grip, Non-Slip Handle, Candy Apple Red
features: COMPACT TONGS HANDLE BIG JOBS: These tongs may be mini, but they provide the grip, strength, and versatility of a full-size set. Their small size uniquely suits them for small hands, so kids can help with breakfast.

PERFECT FOR WAFFLES: Unique hooked end grabs the waffle between the squares to prevent slipping or dropping from waffle maker to plate. The beveled edge slides easily under waffles, releasing the cooked edge from the iron.

PULL RING LOCKS ARMS IN PLACE: Keep the tongs closed with the handy locking mechanism. Pull the ring to lock the tongs in the closed position, and push it in to release the arms. Locking mechanism ensure that tongs fit neatly in drawers.

NON-SLIP SILICONE GRIPS: Strips of non-slip silicone provide grip. Soft-touch silicone feels comfortable in hand, and prevents accidental slips while pulling breakfast off of the waffle maker. The soft-touch silicone will not scratch waffle irons.

DURABLE SILICONE HEADS: BPA-free silicone tips are scratch-resistant, stain-resistant, and food-safe to create the best possible kitchen tool. Silicone is heat resistant up to 600 degrees Fahrenheit, so it can withstand the heat of the waffle iron.
description: Easily lift and grab waffles of all sizes from your waffle maker with the Easy-Grip Silicone Mini Waffle Tongs from Tovolo. Unique hooked end grabs the waffle between the squares to prevent slipping or dropping from waffle maker to plate. The beveled edge slides easily under waffles, releasing the cooked edge from the iron. Strips of non-slip silicone provide grip. Soft-touch silicone feels comfortable in hand, and prevents accidental slips while pulling breakfast off of the waffle maker. The soft-touch silicone will not scratch waffle irons. Keep the tongs closed with the handy locking mechanism. Pull the ring to lock the tongs in the closed position, and push it in to release the arms. Locking mechanism ensure that tongs fit neatly in drawers. Unique shape makes these tongs great for serving, whether in the kitchen or at the buffet. These tongs may be mini, but they provide the grip, strength, and versatility of a full-size set. Their small size uniquely suits them for small hands, so kids can help with breakfast. 8.5" overall length. BPA-free silicone tips are scratch-resistant, stain-resistant, and food-safe to create the best possible kitchen tool. Silicone is heat resistant up to 600 degrees Fahrenheit, so it can withstand the heat of the waffle iron. Made of stainless steel and BPA-free silicone. Dishwasher safe for easy clean up.
